security.title: Security Architecture
security.description: Defense-in-depth security controls protect your data at every layer, from encryption and authentication to access control and auditability.

encryption.title: AES-256 Encryption
encryption.description: All treasury data encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Encryption keys managed with automatic rotation through a dedicated key management service.

mfa.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Enforce multi-factor authentication across your organization, with single sign-on through Microsoft (Entra ID).

rbac.title: Role-Based Access Control
rbac.description: Define granular permissions by entity, function, and transaction amount. Restrict access to sensitive treasury operations with configurable role hierarchies.

dualApproval.title: Dual Approval Workflows
dualApproval.description: Configurable multi-level approval chains for payments, transfers, and sensitive operations. Set thresholds by amount, currency, or counterparty to enforce segregation of duties.

auditLogs.title: Immutable Audit Logs
auditLogs.description: Every user action, system event, and data change is recorded in a tamper-proof audit trail that can be exported for external review.

dataResidency.title: In-Region Hosting
dataResidency.description: Tijori runs in your own OCI tenancy or on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in your region, with disaster recovery in a separate region.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure & Operations
infrastructure.description: Our platform is engineered for reliability, resilience, and operational transparency, so your treasury operations never miss a beat.

faq.title: Security FAQ
faq.description: Answers to the security and compliance questions we hear most from enterprise treasury teams during evaluation.

encryption.question: How is my data encrypted?
encryption.answer: All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Encryption keys are managed through a dedicated key management service with automatic rotation on a regular schedule. Database-level encryption ensures that even raw storage access cannot expose sensitive treasury data.

storage.question: Where is my data stored?
storage.answer: Your data stays in your region. Tijori is deployed either in your own Oracle Cloud (OCI) tenancy or on OCI hosted in your region, with disaster recovery in a separate region.

incidents.question: How do you handle security incidents?
incidents.answer: If a security incident is identified, our team responds 24/7 and works on it around the clock until it is resolved. Affected customers are notified promptly, and we share a post-incident review with them.

sso.question: Do you support Single Sign-On (SSO)?
sso.answer: Yes. Tijori supports single sign-on with Microsoft (Entra ID, formerly Azure Active Directory), so your team signs in with their existing company accounts.
